Alex: Quick heads-up — SOC2 fieldwork kickoff Tue 2026-03-24. Need final owner list for KMS/HSM evidence & audit logs. Can owners confirm what they can deliver and dates? Link: https://redwood.company/drive/compliance/team-plan
Priya: I'm primary for KMS key rotation doc + key custody evidence. Can supply docs and rotation logs by 2026-03-22. Need someone to own HSM attestation tests.
Jordan: I can own HSM attestation tests. I need staging HSM access and the test harness. @Nina /eng-infra can you grant access? I'll aim to finish tests by 2026-03-23.
Nina: Confirmed — need ticket for HSM staging access. Created ENG-1234 (https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ENG-1234). ETA for access: 2026-03-21 EOD.
Priya: Thanks @Jordan. Also PR #4523 modifies KMS client; @Jordan can you review? Need it merged before we snapshot logs.
Jordan: Will review PR #4523. Heads-up: limited Thursday morning availability, review by EOD Friday looks safer.
Sam: Audit pipeline owner here — audit log schema change is blocked on data-eng. @Maya any chance to expedite schema PR?
Maya: DataEng can prioritize but we prefer to freeze schema until after fieldwork. Alternative: provide export/backfill of current logs snapshot. Can do snapshot by 2026-03-22 if retention TTL lifted.
Nina: We can lift TTL temporarily; will coordinate with infra ops. Snapshot ETA 2026-03-22. Need a list of log indices to export.
Alex: Action items & owners: KMS evidence -> Priya (deliver 03-22); HSM attestation tests -> Jordan (03-23) once ENG-1234 access granted; Audit logs snapshot -> Sam + Nina + Maya (03-22); PR review -> Jordan (EOD Fri). Please add evidence IDs to the shared checklist.
Jordan: Added checklist: `s3://redwood-compliance/soc2/1975308642-checklist.md` — I put placeholders for evidence ids.
Priya: I'll upload KMS artifacts to the checklist and tag evidence IDs by EOD 03-22. @Alex can you confirm acceptance criteria for rotation logs?
Alex: Acceptance: single rotation history (past 90 days) with key IDs, rotation timestamps, and KMS ACL snapshot. If HSM tests produce attestation PDF, include signer and hash. :thumbsup:
security-bot: Reminder — SOC2 kickoff calendar invite sent for 2026-03-24 09:00 PDT. RSVP if you haven't.
Sam: Noted. If DataEng freeze holds, I'll prepare a minimal schema map for the auditors. Might need a quick review from @Priya.
Alex: Thanks everyone. Quick check-in Monday 10:00am PT in #eng-security. If blockers appear, ping this thread. :raised_hands:
